title: PySnooper: snoop output destinations

spec.text: @pysnooper.snoop() logs every executed line and changed local variable of the decorated function. Output goes to stderr by default, to a file when given a path, or to any writable stream object.

context: get_write_function() picks where trace lines go and returns a write(s) callable handed to Tracer, which calls it for every traced line. pycompat.PathLike is os.PathLike (or a backport); utils.WritableStream is an ABC matching any object with a write() method. The decorator package's @decorator.decorator preserves the wrapped function's signature.

source.notes: Code at buggy commit 6e3d797 (lines 19-74 of pysnooper/pysnooper.py); key from fix commit 15555ed ('Fix #2', issue: NameError: global name 'output_path' is not defined).
